summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the Board of Directors' unanimous approval to exonerate Officer Ana Paula Vitali Janes Vescovi, effective June 29, 2026. The filing is a board meeting minutes excerpt detailing the officer's removal. No transaction, price, premium, or advisors are mentioned. The event is an abrupt officer departure, constituting a management change. As a non-US filing, this 6-K is equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K for a significant executive change. Watch for any subsequent filings detailing the reason or successor appointment.
